description: This file contains functions and types related to processing and delivering reply payloads in an auto-reply system, including normalization of reply directives, handling reply delivery with optional streaming, and managing reply payloads with media and silent modes.

methods.name: normalizeReplyPayloadDirectives
methods.description: Normalizes reply payloads by parsing directives based on the specified parse mode and silent token, trimming whitespace if needed, and returning the updated payload along with silent status.

methods.name: createBlockReplyDeliveryHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler function for delivering reply payloads, supporting streaming, media normalization, silent mode, and callback invocation, with logic to handle various reply delivery scenarios.
